css: .ob-checkbox-input{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;opacity:0;cursor:inherit}.ob-checkbox-caixa{display:block;pointer-events:none;border-radius:var(--ob-r-xs);transition:box-shadow var(--ob-dur-fast) var(--ob-ease),transform var(--ob-dur-fast) var(--ob-ease)}.ob-checkbox-fundo{fill:var(--ob-surface);stroke:var(--ob-fg-mute);transition:fill var(--ob-dur-fast) var(--ob-ease),stroke var(--ob-dur-fast) var(--ob-ease)}.ob-checkbox-caixa:not([data-estado="off"]) .ob-checkbox-fundo{fill:var(--ob-blue);stroke:var(--ob-blue)}.ob-checkbox-caixa[data-estado="off"][data-erro] .ob-checkbox-fundo{stroke:var(--ob-danger)}.ob-checkbox:not([data-disabled]):hover .ob-checkbox-caixa[data-estado="off"]:not([data-erro]) .ob-checkbox-fundo{stroke:var(--ob-fg-soft)}.ob-checkbox:not([data-disabled]):hover .ob-checkbox-caixa:not([data-estado="off"]) .ob-checkbox-fundo{fill:var(--ob-blue-700);stroke:var(--ob-blue-700)}.ob-checkbox:not([data-disabled]):active .ob-checkbox-caixa{transform:scale(0.9)}.ob-checkbox-input:focus-visible+.ob-checkbox-caixa{box-shadow:0 0 0 var(--ob-focus-ring-width) var(--ob-focus-ring)}.ob-checkbox-glifo{fill:var(--ob-fg-on-color);stroke:var(--ob-fg-on-color);transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}.ob-checkbox-glifo[data-animar]{animation:ob-checkbox-entra var(--ob-dur-fast) var(--ob-ease-out) both}@keyframes ob-checkbox-entra{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(0.5)}}

.ob-sa-viewport{scrollbar-width:none;-ms-overflow-style:none}.ob-sa-viewport::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}.ob-sa-viewport:focus{outline:none}.ob-sa-viewport:focus-visible{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 var(--ob-focus-ring-width) var(--ob-focus-ring)}.ob-sa-barra{position:absolute;z-index:1;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;touch-action:none;user-select:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity var(--ob-dur-base) var(--ob-ease)}.ob-sa-barra[data-eixo="v"]{top:0;right:0;width:12px;padding:var(--ob-space-2) var(--ob-space-4);flex-direction:column}.ob-sa-barra[data-eixo="h"]{left:0;bottom:0;height:12px;padding:var(--ob-space-4) var(--ob-space-2);flex-direction:row}.ob-sa-polegar{position:relative;border-radius:var(--ob-r-pill);background:var(--ob-scrollbar-thumb);transition:background var(--ob-dur-fast) var(--ob-ease),width var(--ob-dur-fast) var(--ob-ease),height var(--ob-dur-fast) var(--ob-ease);cursor:default}.ob-sa-barra[data-eixo="v"] .ob-sa-polegar{width:6px;align-self:center}.ob-sa-barra[data-eixo="h"] .ob-sa-polegar{height:6px;align-self:center}.ob-sa-barra:hover .ob-sa-polegar,.ob-sa-polegar[data-arrastando]{background:var(--ob-scrollbar-thumb-hover)}.ob-sa-barra[data-eixo="v"]:hover .ob-sa-polegar,.ob-sa-barra[data-eixo="v"] .ob-sa-polegar[data-arrastando]{width:8px}.ob-sa-barra[data-eixo="h"]:hover .ob-sa-polegar,.ob-sa-barra[data-eixo="h"] .ob-sa-polegar[data-arrastando]{height:8px}.ob-sa[data-visibilidade="always"] .ob-sa-barra{background:var(--ob-scrollbar-track);border-radius:var(--ob-r-pill)}.ob-sa[data-visibilidade="auto"] .ob-sa-barra,.ob-sa[data-visibilidade="always"] .ob-sa-barra,.ob-sa:hover .ob-sa-barra,.ob-sa:focus-within .ob-sa-barra,.ob-sa[data-ativa] .ob-sa-barra{opacity:1}

.ob-sidebar-borda{position:absolute;top:50%;right:calc(var(--ob-space-16) * -1);transform:translate(50%,-50%);z-index:1;opacity:0;transition:opacity var(--ob-dur-fast) var(--ob-ease)}.ob-sidebar:hover .ob-sidebar-borda,.ob-sidebar-borda:focus-within{opacity:1}.ob-sidebar-abrir{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:var(--ob-r-control);background:transparent;color:var(--ob-fg-soft);cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--ob-dur-fast) var(--ob-ease)}.ob-sidebar-abrir>*{grid-area:1/1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:opacity var(--ob-dur-fast) var(--ob-ease)}.ob-sidebar-abrir__icone{opacity:0}.ob-sidebar-abrir[data-sem-marca] .ob-sidebar-abrir__icone{opacity:1}.ob-sidebar-abrir:hover,.ob-sidebar-abrir:focus-visible{background:var(--ob-bg-warm)}.ob-sidebar-abrir:hover .ob-sidebar-abrir__marca,.ob-sidebar-abrir:focus-visible .ob-sidebar-abrir__marca{opacity:0}.ob-sidebar-abrir:hover .ob-sidebar-abrir__icone,.ob-sidebar-abrir:focus-visible .ob-sidebar-abrir__icone{opacity:1}.ob-sidebar-abrir:focus-visible{outline:var(--ob-focus-ring-width) solid var(--ob-focus-ring);outline-offset:calc(var(--ob-focus-ring-width) * -1)}@media (hover: none){.ob-sidebar-borda{opacity:1}.ob-sidebar-abrir__marca{opacity:0}.ob-sidebar-abrir__icone{opacity:1}}.ob-sidebar-item.ob-sidebar-item{background:transparent;color:var(--ob-fg-soft);transition:background var(--ob-dur-fast) var(--ob-ease),color var(--ob-dur-fast) var(--ob-ease)}.ob-sidebar-item.ob-sidebar-item[data-grupo]{color:var(--ob-fg-strong)}.ob-sidebar-item.ob-sidebar-item:hover:not([data-ativo]){background:var(--ob-bg-warm);color:var(--ob-fg-strong)}.ob-sidebar-item:focus-visible{outline:var(--ob-focus-ring-width) solid var(--ob-focus-ring);outline-offset:calc(var(--ob-focus-ring-width) * -1)}
@keyframes ob-fade { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } } @keyframes ob-pop { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.96) translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); } }
